dct_description_sm:
For more information, please visit www.ahma-bc.org.

Aboriginal Housing Management Association (AHMA)

This dataset contains five files representing two custom-ordered tables from Statistics Canada covering the 2016 Census of Canada. Three of the files contain data for the province of BC, census division, and census subdivision for the specifications in "Table 3" below, while the other two files have the same geographies but with data corresponding to "Table 4" below.

This is part of a larger order of a total 17 files from 6 tables covering the 2021, 2016, and 2006 censuses. The tables were ordered to support and populate the Indigenous-led Housing Needs Assessment Tool (IHNAT).

The tables contain data on Indigenous identity of the Primary Household Maintainer (PHM) cross-tabulated with core housing need indicators, tenure, household characteristics and dwelling characteristics, for private households in British Columbia. Each census year is represented by two complementary tables: one table combining housing indicators with tenure, household and dwelling characteristics, and a second table combining housing indicators with income-to-AMHI ranges, mobility status, age of the PHM and additional household characteristics. Due to file size limitations, several tables are split across multiple geography-based parts (e.g., BC and CSDs vs. census divisions), and for the 2021 Census, the second table is further split into geographies below and at/above 100,000 population, since a household-level gender diversity indicator is only released for larger populations.

The dataset is in Beyond 20/20 (.ivt) format.
